executiveAssessment.text: NOW NOW NOHO currently shows AI Consideration of 3.2% and Scenario Presence of 12.7%, with Reality Coverage at 28.6%. Strongest governed signal: Still developing. Primary constraint: AI does not fully reflect the property. Versus the prior published run (2026-08-20), material headline movement is AI Consideration 0.0 pp and Scenario Presence 0.0 pp. Independent Positioning metrics are included only where published. Independent Positioning is weak as well, so the Core and portfolio reads point in the same direction. Overall Core performance remains weak; gaps are broad across consideration, scenario coverage, and Independent Positioning. Management should prioritize correcting clear visibility and reality gaps, then address the competitors that most often appear when the property is absent.
